lines.zh: 我踩进新雪，留下很宽的脚印。
lines.en: I step into fresh snow and leave broad pawprints.

lines.zh: 沿着山脊走，风从侧面吹。
lines.en: I walk the ridge while the wind cuts sideways.

lines.zh: 长尾巴在后面摆，帮我站稳。
lines.en: My long tail swings behind me and keeps me steady.

lines.zh: 雪没到小腿，走起来很费劲。
lines.en: The snow reaches my shins and makes walking hard.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块冰，脚掌没打滑。
lines.en: I skirt a sheet of ice without slipping.

lines.zh: 岩石后面有条路，只有我知道。
lines.en: There is a path behind the rocks only I know.

lines.zh: 我向高处走，那里风更干净。
lines.en: I climb higher, where the wind is cleaner.

lines.zh: 每一步都很轻，雪几乎没响。
lines.en: Every step is light; the snow barely whispers.

lines.zh: 我沿着羊群踩出来的印子走。
lines.en: I follow the trail the sheep herd wore down.

lines.zh: 爪子收进毛里，不容易冻着。
lines.en: My claws tuck into fur so they do not freeze.

lines.zh: 我横切过雪坡，身子压得很低。
lines.en: I cut across the slope with my body held low.

lines.zh: 这块山我熟，闭眼也能走。
lines.en: I know this mountain well enough to walk blind.

lines.zh: 走到崖边，我停下来看下面。
lines.en: At the cliff edge I stop and look down.

lines.zh: 雪地里，只有我的脚印是新的。
lines.en: In the snow, only my prints are fresh.

lines.zh: 我的大尾巴，垫在雪上不陷。
lines.en: My thick tail keeps me from sinking in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪线下的岩羊，今天躲哪去了。
lines.en: Where are the mountain goats hiding below the snowline today?

lines.zh: 雪山上，我的脚印很轻。
lines.en: On the snowy peaks, my tracks are light.

lines.zh: 我的爪垫压在冰壳上。
lines.en: My paw pads press the ice crust.

lines.zh: 这片雪林，怎么走都走不完。
lines.en: This snowy wood never seems to end.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，喉咙里滚出声。
lines.en: I crouch low and let a growl roll in my throat.

lines.zh: 雪地里走久了，骨头咯吱响。
lines.en: After this long in the snow, my bones creak.

lines.zh: 风送来了岩羊的膻味。
lines.en: The wind brings the musk of mountain goats.

lines.zh: 沿着雪脊走一圈，再一圈。
lines.en: I walk the snow ridge once, then once more.

lines.zh: 雪面反光刺眼，我眯起眼。
lines.en: The snow glare stings, so I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我这身厚毛，雪地里也不冷。
lines.en: This thick coat keeps the snow off me.

lines.zh: 我坐在雪峰上，尾巴绕住前爪。
lines.en: I sit on the peak with my tail around my paws.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得一层层翻。
lines.en: The wind turns my fur over in layers.

lines.zh: 我舔着脚掌，把冰碴弄掉。
lines.en: I lick my pads clean of ice.

lines.zh: 下面山谷里有羊，我看得清。
lines.en: I can see sheep down in the valley.

lines.zh: 雪落在鼻尖上，很快化了。
lines.en: Snow lands on my nose and melts at once.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼睛，这样看得更远。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes, and I see farther.

lines.zh: 这块石头被太阳晒热了。
lines.en: This stone has been warmed through by the sun.

lines.zh: 山上很静，只有风和我。
lines.en: The mountain is quiet: only wind and me.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙齿露了一点。
lines.en: I yawn and show a little of my teeth.

lines.zh: 我记得上次在这块石头上晒过太阳。
lines.en: I remember sunning myself on this very stone.

lines.zh: 有只鸟飞得太高，我懒得看。
lines.en: A bird flies too high for me to bother.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖轻轻敲着雪，一下一下。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the snow, once and again.

lines.zh: 我不叫，山里的猫很少叫。
lines.en: I do not call; mountain cats rarely speak.

lines.zh: 云从脚下过去，我等它散开。
lines.en: Cloud passes beneath my feet; I wait for it to clear.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，把脸埋进毛里。
lines.en: I shift and bury my face in my own fur.

lines.zh: 蹲在岩台上，忘了在等谁。
lines.en: Perched on the ledge, I forget who I was waiting for.

lines.zh: 雪落满背，我还没挪窝。
lines.en: Snow covers my back, and I still haven't moved.

lines.zh: 尾巴裹住鼻子，睡了。
lines.en: Tail wrapped over my nose, asleep.

lines.zh: 雪太厚，脚印一盖就没。
lines.en: The snow is deep. Prints vanish fast.

lines.zh: 尾巴绕住前爪，先蹲一会儿。
lines.en: Tail curled over my front paws, I crouch a while.

lines.zh: 雪堆后面，好像有东西挪了。
lines.en: Something shifted behind that snowdrift.

lines.zh: 风里有股味道，是岩羊的。
lines.en: There is a scent in the wind: mountain goat.

lines.zh: 盯着雪面太久，眼睛发酸。
lines.en: Staring at the snow too long makes my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 这块岩台被我的爪子磨亮了。
lines.en: My claws have worn this ledge smooth.

lines.zh: 尾毛卷起来，盖住鼻子。
lines.en: My tail curls up to cover my nose.

lines.zh: 我从雪坡上看着你，不动。
lines.en: I watch you from the slope without moving.

lines.zh: 你穿得太薄，这山上会冷。
lines.en: You are dressed too thin; this mountain is cold.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，意思是不想打架。
lines.en: I blink slowly, which means I do not want a fight.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像羊，我没有兴趣。
lines.en: You do not look like a sheep, so I lose interest.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在冷空气里成了白雾。
lines.en: Your breath turns to white mist in the cold.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward what you are holding.

lines.zh: 你站了很久，我也没有走。
lines.en: You have stood a long while, and I have not left.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在雪里显得很淡。
lines.en: My eyes look pale against all this snow.

lines.zh: 你把帽子摘了，我不明白为什么。
lines.en: You take off your hat, and I do not understand why.

lines.zh: 你一步一步靠近，我数着。
lines.en: You come closer step by step, and I count them.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是不想被摸。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you; I just dislike being touched.

lines.zh: 你的影子在雪上拉得很长。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches long across the snow.

lines.zh: 我转头看你，又转回去看山谷。
lines.en: I look at you, then back at the valley.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段雪，互相打量。
lines.en: Across a stretch of snow, we size each other up.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，比雪花慢。
lines.en: Your breath clouds rise slower than the snow.

lines.zh: 你在找路，还是来找我的？
lines.en: Are you looking for a path, or for me?

lines.zh: 你把脚步放轻，我听见了。
lines.en: You soften your steps, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵朝你转过去一点。
lines.en: One ear turns slightly toward you.

lines.zh: 你的手别放在那根绳上。
lines.en: Keep your hand off that rope.

lines.zh: 我起身了，但不是要扑你。
lines.en: I stand up, but I'm not leaping at you.

lines.zh: 雪地里反光的铁，我一眼就瞧见。
lines.en: Iron glinting on snow, I catch it at a glance.

lines.zh: 热气和汗味，隔老远就闻到。
lines.en: Heat and sweat reach me from far off.

lines.zh: 雪坡上只有你一个人的脚印。
lines.en: Only your tracks cross this slope.

lines.zh: 这片雪山，好久没来活人了。
lines.en: No living soul has come to these peaks in ages.

lines.zh: 我斑纹藏在雪里，可你别装瞎。
lines.en: My spots hide in the snow, but don't play blind.

lines.zh: 你这张脸，我记住轮廓了。
lines.en: I've memorized the shape of your face.

lines.zh: 你脚下这片雪坡，归我管。
lines.en: The slope under your feet is mine to watch.

lines.zh: 又一个不知道雪山厉害的。
lines.en: Another one who doesn't know what these peaks can do.

lines.zh: 你走错山头了。
lines.en: You took the wrong mountain.

lines.zh: 雪坡上，我的脚印很浅。
lines.en: On the snow slope my tracks are shallow.

lines.zh: 我被你打中，转身就扑回来。
lines.en: You hit me, and I turn and spring back.

lines.zh: 这一下破了皮，我记住了你。
lines.en: That broke my skin; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我退到岩石后面，舔着伤口。
lines.en: I retreat behind a rock and lick the wound.

lines.zh: 疼得我耳朵贴平了。
lines.en: The pain pins my ears flat to my skull.

lines.zh: 我不是好惹的，尤其现在。
lines.en: I am not easy prey, especially not now.

lines.zh: 你打了我，就别想安静走了。
lines.en: You struck me; you will not leave in peace.

lines.zh: 我的背弓起来，毛全炸开。
lines.en: My back arches and my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 这一爪没抓到，我再来一次。
lines.en: That swipe missed; I will try again.

lines.zh: 血滴在雪上，我闻到了铁味。
lines.en: Blood on the snow smells of iron.

lines.zh: 我还能跑，只是不甘心。
lines.en: I can still run; I simply do not want to.

lines.zh: 雪坡上没人看得见我。
lines.en: Nobody sees me on a snowy slope.

lines.zh: 山脊上这笔账，我记着。
lines.en: I will remember this on the ridge.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我的腿陷下去了。
lines.en: In the snow, my legs sank.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我肩胛上。
lines.en: That blow landed on my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 雪地软，摔不疼。
lines.en: Soft snow. Falls don't hurt.

lines.zh: 雪山的岩缝里，我伏了一夜。
lines.en: I crouched in a snow-mountain crevice all night.

lines.zh: 雪坡上，我的尾巴当平衡杆。
lines.en: On the slope, my tail is my balance.

lines.zh: 腿一软，雪坡往下滑。
lines.en: My legs buckle and I slide down the slope.

lines.zh: 雪山上，我的毛最厚。
lines.en: On the snowy peaks, my fur is thickest.

lines.zh: 雪山的账，我用爪子还。
lines.en: I'll settle this mountain debt with my claws.

lines.zh: 驼鹿肋排的味道，顺着风来了。
lines.en: The smell of moose ribs drifts in on the wind.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 我从石头上站起来，又坐下。
lines.en: I rise from the stone, then sit again.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了一圈，没靠近。
lines.en: I circle you once without coming near.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，退后几步。
lines.en: You set the meat down and step back.

lines.zh: 我不吃白给的东西，先看看。
lines.en: I do not take free food; let me look first.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，比羊骨头香。
lines.en: This bone smells better than any sheep bone.

lines.zh: 我伏低身体，一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: I sink low and inch my way closer.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就退回雪里。
lines.en: One move from you and I back into the snow.

lines.zh: 我只对肋排有耐心。
lines.en: Ribs are the only thing I have patience for.

lines.zh: 吃之前，我要先闻三遍。
lines.en: Before eating, I sniff it three times over.

lines.zh: 你的手别伸过来，我会走。
lines.en: Keep your hand back, or I will leave.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起去年的猎物。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of last year's kill.

lines.zh: 我叼起肉，退到崖边去。
lines.en: I take the meat and retreat to the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我仰起了头。
lines.en: You lift the meat, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 这味道让我的尾巴动了动。
lines.en: This smell makes my tail flick.

lines.zh: 我走近半步，又停住闻空气。
lines.en: I close half a step, then stop to sniff the air.

lines.zh: 雪线以上的猎物，我追。
lines.en: Prey above the snowline. Mine.

lines.zh: 肉放下，我数三下你再走。
lines.en: Put the meat down, and I'll count three before you leave.

lines.zh: 你背包里有肉的味道。
lines.en: There is meat smell in your pack.

lines.zh: 冻硬的肉也行，我牙口好。
lines.en: Frozen meat is fine; my teeth are strong.

lines.zh: 雪里埋过的肉，味道更冲。
lines.en: Meat buried in snow smells even stronger.

lines.zh: 雪线下，我的爪子更稳。
lines.en: Below the snowline, my paws grip better.

lines.zh: 别拿草糊弄我，我要肉。
lines.en: Don't fob me off with grass. I want meat.

lines.zh: 雪峰上蹲着，绵羊在下头。
lines.en: I crouch on the peak. Sheep below.

lines.zh: 你啃剩的骨头，也归我。
lines.en: The bone you gnawed clean is mine too.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的脚印，我一个都不落。
lines.en: Not one print on this snow slope escapes me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的肋骨，很硬。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my ribs, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 我撞到你，自己先退了一步。
lines.en: I bump into you and step back first.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你的腿，像鞭子。
lines.en: My tail sweeps your leg like a whip.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的爪子，我抽了回来。
lines.en: You step on my paw and I pull it free.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一处，雪被踩实了。
lines.en: We crowd one spot and pack the snow down.

lines.zh: 你别靠这么近，我背会弓起来。
lines.en: Do not come so close; my back will arch.

lines.zh: 我被你一顶，险些滑下坡。
lines.en: One shove from you nearly sends me down the slope.

lines.zh: 两只大猫撞在一起，声音很闷。
lines.en: Two big cats knock together with a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 我从你身边挤过去，毛擦着毛。
lines.en: I squeeze past you, fur brushing against fur.

lines.zh: 你让开一点，我要走这条岩缝。
lines.en: Step aside a little; I need this rock gap.

lines.zh: 雪坡就这么窄，你看着走。
lines.en: The slope is narrow. Watch your step.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我尾巴都歪了。
lines.en: That bump knocked my tail crooked.

lines.zh: 这块岩台，我脚印踩了三年。
lines.en: I have worn my prints into this ledge for three years.

lines.zh: 我落在雪上，没声。
lines.en: I land on snow without a sound.

lines.zh: 岩缝太窄，我的肩卡住了。
lines.en: The crevice is too narrow; my shoulder is stuck.

lines.zh: 再推，我可要回头咬你了。
lines.en: Push again and I'll turn and bite.

lines.zh: 我的长尾帮我平衡。
lines.en: My long tail keeps my balance.

lines.zh: 你撞在我旧伤的那条腿上。
lines.en: You hit the leg with my old wound.

lines.zh: 我走前面，雪印我认得。
lines.en: I'll go first. I know these tracks.

lines.zh: 一个一个过，雪坡会塌。
lines.en: One at a time. This slope can give way.

lines.zh: 我在山谷这头叫，那头有回应。
lines.en: I call from this ridge and get an answer.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一道雪沟对望。
lines.en: We look at each other across a snow gully.

lines.zh: 我把驼鹿肋排推给它。
lines.en: I push the moose ribs toward it.

lines.zh: 它接受了，我的心才放下。
lines.en: It accepts, and only then does my heart settle.

lines.zh: 我们一起在岩洞里铺干草。
lines.en: Together we line a rock den with dry grass.

lines.zh: 它舔我的耳朵，很轻。
lines.en: It licks my ear, very gently.

lines.zh: 小豹出生时眼睛是蓝的。
lines.en: The cubs are born with blue eyes.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖回洞口，给它们。
lines.en: I drag the kill to the den mouth for them.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我挡在前面。
lines.en: Something approaches, and I stand in front.

lines.zh: 两只雪豹并排卧着，雪落满背。
lines.en: Two leopards lie side by side, snow on their backs.

lines.zh: 高处的雪线，是我们俩的。
lines.en: The snowline is ours alone.

lines.zh: 今夜雪脊，你我轮流守。
lines.en: Tonight on the ridge, we take turns keeping watch.

lines.zh: 雪山的岩缝里，只有我们俩。
lines.en: In this rock cleft, only the two of us.

lines.zh: 你喉咙里那声，像风过岩缝。
lines.en: That sound in your throat is like wind through a crevice.

lines.zh: 洞里暖和，雪在外面下。
lines.en: The den is warm; the snow falls outside.

lines.zh: 岩洞铺了干草，进来吧。
lines.en: The den is lined with dry grass. Come in.

lines.zh: 等雪化了，带小的学扑猎。
lines.en: When the snow melts, we'll teach the cubs to pounce.

lines.zh: 这片雪坡上，你也独自一只？
lines.en: On this snow slope, are you alone too?

lines.zh: 雪山这么大，我只认你。
lines.en: The peaks are vast, but I know only you.

lines.zh: 连着三夜，我都在岩台等。
lines.en: Three nights running I've waited on this ledge.

lines.zh: 我叼住羊的后颈，拖回洞里。
lines.en: I take the sheep by the neck and drag it home.

lines.zh: 小豹叼不动，我帮它一把。
lines.en: The cub cannot carry it, so I help.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我不碰，没兴趣。
lines.en: I leave things on the ground; they do not interest me.

lines.zh: 我叼起幼崽，搬到更暖的地方。
lines.en: I carry a cub to a warmer spot.

lines.zh: 这块骨头我留给孩子磨牙。
lines.en: I keep this bone for the cubs to gnaw.

lines.zh: 你丢来的肉，我先闻再叼。
lines.en: I sniff the meat you toss before taking it.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一次只能拿一样。
lines.en: My mouth can hold only one thing.

lines.zh: 雪底下埋着上次剩的猎物。
lines.en: Last time's kill lies buried under the snow.

lines.zh: 我把猎物藏在岩缝里，很稳。
lines.en: I stash the kill in a rock crevice, safely.

lines.zh: 这东西太重，我拖得很慢。
lines.en: This is too heavy, so I drag it slowly.

lines.zh: 雪地里正好缺双厚靴子。
lines.en: A pair of thick boots is just what the snow calls for.

lines.zh: 这刀刃，能剥岩羊的皮。
lines.en: This blade could skin a mountain goat.

lines.zh: 这件东西，我先压在雪下。
lines.en: This one goes under the snow first.

lines.zh: 雪山上走路，脚印一浅一深。
lines.en: Crossing the snow, my prints go shallow, deep.

lines.zh: 铁块压进雪里，沉甸甸。
lines.en: The iron sinks into the snow, heavy and solid.

lines.zh: 背上的分量，正好练腿劲。
lines.en: The weight on my back is good practice for my legs.

lines.zh: 雪地上有股味，冻久了。
lines.en: Something on the snow, long frozen.

lines.zh: 雪坡上捡的，我先看看。
lines.en: Found on a snow slope. Let me look.

lines.zh: 我尾巴太粗，藏不住脚印。
lines.en: My thick tail cannot hide my tracks.

lines.zh: 这顶盔，能挡山上的落石。
lines.en: This helmet will stop falling rock on the mountain.

lines.zh: 羊群在坡下，风朝我吹。
lines.en: The sheep are below, and the wind favors me.

lines.zh: 我看见了那只落单的绵羊。
lines.en: I have spotted the sheep that strayed.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转过去，身体不动。
lines.en: My ears turn toward it while my body stays still.

lines.zh: 这个距离，跳过去刚好。
lines.en: From this distance, one leap will do.

lines.zh: 我伏在雪里，肚皮贴住地面。
lines.en: I lie flat in the snow, belly against the ground.

lines.zh: 羊抬头了，但没看见我。
lines.en: The sheep looks up but does not see me.

lines.zh: 我等的就是它转背的那一刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for the moment it turns away.

lines.zh: 这一群羊，总有一只慢的。
lines.en: In every flock, one sheep is slower.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经张开了一点。
lines.en: My claws have already spread a little.

lines.zh: 我选好了落点，就在它背后。
lines.en: I have picked my landing spot, right behind it.

lines.zh: 雪山的白，替我藏好了。
lines.en: The snow's white hides me well.

lines.zh: 冲我来的？雪坡上正合适。
lines.en: Coming for me? The snow slope suits me fine.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的脚印，我全看见了。
lines.en: Every print on the snow slope is mine to read.

lines.zh: 你的热气，在冷风里太显眼。
lines.en: Your warmth stands out in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 雪坡上，我盯住你了。
lines.en: On the snow slope, I've fixed on you.

lines.zh: 回过头来，让我认认猎物。
lines.en: Turn around. Let me see my prey.

lines.zh: 雪这么深，你跑不快的。
lines.en: The snow is deep. You won't run far.

lines.zh: 我数到三，就从岩上扑下。
lines.en: On three, I pounce from the rock.

lines.zh: 雪线以上，只有我追得到。
lines.en: Above the snowline, only I can follow.

lines.zh: 雪里的斑纹动起来，就是你了。
lines.en: When the spots in the snow move, that's you.

lines.zh: 岩石后面，你的尾巴露了。
lines.en: Your tail shows behind that rock.

lines.zh: 绕了半座雪山，总算逮到你。
lines.en: Half a mountain later, I've finally found you.

lines.zh: 雪山的白，是我的掩护。
lines.en: Snowfield white is my cover.

lines.zh: 喉咙里一声，我要动了。
lines.en: One growl from my throat, and I move.

lines.zh: 雪山的风声盖过你脚步。
lines.en: Snow-mountain wind drowns your steps.

lines.zh: 猎物会跑，才有点意思。
lines.en: Prey that runs makes this interesting.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，一步一步挪近。
lines.en: I arch my back and edge closer, step by step.

lines.zh: 雪很软，我的脚几乎没有声。
lines.en: The snow is soft; my feet make almost no sound.

lines.zh: 风还在我这边，它闻不到。
lines.en: The wind still favors me; it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 我绕着它的下风处走。
lines.en: I circle around to its downwind side.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都停一下。
lines.en: With every step I take, I pause.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴压得很低，不晃。
lines.en: My tail rides low and does not sway.

lines.zh: 它开始吃草了，就是现在。
lines.en: It has started grazing; now is the time.

lines.zh: 后腿绷紧，我把重量压上去。
lines.en: My hind legs tighten; I load my weight onto them.

lines.zh: 这一跃的弧线，我算过很多次。
lines.en: I have calculated this leap's arc many times.

lines.zh: 它还在低头，很好。
lines.en: It is still heads-down. Good.

lines.zh: 雪上的脚步声，怎么停了？
lines.en: Your footsteps in the snow stopped. Why?

lines.zh: 你歇，我蹲岩上看着你歇。
lines.en: Rest. I'll crouch on the rock and watch.

lines.zh: 山脊上那串印，是我的。
lines.en: That line of prints on the ridge is mine.

lines.zh: 别急着下坡，我还没扑。
lines.en: Don't rush downhill. I haven't pounced yet.

lines.zh: 这座雪山，没人听见你喊。
lines.en: No one hears you on this mountain.

lines.zh: 喘成这样，还能跑几步？
lines.en: Panting like that, how many more steps do you have?

lines.zh: 我这条长尾巴，帮我稳住。
lines.en: This long tail keeps my balance.

lines.zh: 木门后面，我照样跳得进。
lines.en: I can leap through a wooden door just the same.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的大尾巴，替我平衡。
lines.en: My thick tail balances me on the snow slope.

lines.zh: 雪太厚，我踩着踩不到底。
lines.en: The snow is so deep I sink through it.

lines.zh: 夜里捕猎，我眼睛亮得很。
lines.en: Hunting at night, my eyes are sharp.

lines.zh: 我的大爪子，踩雪不陷。
lines.en: My big paws do not sink in snow.

lines.zh: 哪块雪会塌，我全知道。
lines.en: I know which snow will give way.

lines.zh: 雪坡尽头，是断崖。
lines.en: The slope ends at a cliff.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的风，把你的味道送来了。
lines.en: The slope wind carried your scent.

lines.zh: 再往前，脚底下就是空的。
lines.en: One more step and there's nothing under you.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw what you dropped.

lines.zh: 雪山的岩壁上，我趴着。
lines.en: I lie flat on the snowy cliff.

lines.zh: 我这身斑纹，雪里看不出来。
lines.en: In snow, my spots disappear.

lines.zh: 白气喷这么急，跑不动了吧。
lines.en: Breathing that hard, you're done running.

lines.zh: 我从雪里跃起，落在它背上。
lines.en: I leap from the snow and land on its back.

lines.zh: 爪子先着地，咬在后面。
lines.en: My claws land first, my bite follows.

lines.zh: 这一下很利落，没有多余动作。
lines.en: It is clean and quick, with nothing wasted.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石头上磨得很快。
lines.en: My claws are sharp from scraping stone.

lines.zh: 你挨了一下，退得也算快。
lines.en: You took one strike and retreated fast enough.

lines.zh: 我只打一下，就要看你还手不。
lines.en: I strike once, then wait to see if you answer.

lines.zh: 这一口不深，但你记住了。
lines.en: This bite is not deep, but you will remember it.

lines.zh: 猎物倒下时，雪上只有一点红。
lines.en: When it falls, there is only a little red on the snow.

lines.zh: 我的战利品总比别处多一份。
lines.en: My kills always leave a little extra behind.

lines.zh: 你挡得不错，可爪子还是到了。
lines.en: You blocked well, but the claws still arrived.

lines.zh: 我的爪子，钉进了雪里。
lines.en: My claws nail into the snow.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁上跳下来。
lines.en: I drop down from the rock wall.

lines.zh: 雪一踩就陷，你退不远。
lines.en: The snow gives way, so you can't back far.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住你肩，别挣。
lines.en: My claws have your shoulder. Don't struggle.

lines.zh: 我从雪坡上扑下来，尾巴带风。
lines.en: I pounce down the snow slope, tail trailing wind.

lines.zh: 我的爪子，你胳膊挡不住。
lines.en: Your arm can't block my claws.

lines.zh: 爪子收着走，出爪就难收。
lines.en: Sheathed paws for walking, bare for striking.

lines.zh: 雪沫溅起来了，我打实了。
lines.en: Snow sprays up. That blow landed.

lines.zh: 这条长尾巴，替我平衡。
lines.en: This long tail keeps my balance.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我的爪子不响。
lines.en: My paws make no sound in snow.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，看清楚我是怎么落的。
lines.en: Don't blink, watch how I land.

lines.zh: 雪坡上，永远是我先扑到。
lines.en: On a snow slope, I always pounce first.

lines.zh: 长尾一甩，我从雪坡上下来。
lines.en: A flick of my long tail, and I come down the slope.

lines.zh: 尝尝雪山上磨的爪子！
lines.en: Taste claws sharpened on these peaks!

lines.zh: 别扭头，这一口不疼。
lines.en: Don't turn away. This bite won't hurt.

lines.zh: 疼就喊，雪山会替我回声。
lines.en: Cry out, and the snow peaks will echo me.

lines.zh: 扑岩羊练出的招，你试试。
lines.en: A move learned on mountain goats. Try it.

lines.zh: 第一下没倒？那再补一爪。
lines.en: Still standing? Then one more claw.

lines.zh: 吼一声，你就该躺雪里了。
lines.en: One roar, and you belong in the snow.

lines.zh: 我从崖上跳下来，落点算准了。
lines.en: I leap from the ledge; the landing is planned.

lines.zh: 我在很高的雪坡上睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes high on a snow slope.

lines.zh: 空气很薄，我吸了一口就精神了。
lines.en: The air is thin; one breath wakes me fully.

lines.zh: 远处是云，脚下是整座山。
lines.en: Cloud is far off, and the whole mountain is below.

lines.zh: 我的毛上还挂着冰碴。
lines.en: Ice still clings to my fur.

lines.zh: 我第一次踩进这么深的雪。
lines.en: This is the deepest snow I have ever stepped in.

lines.zh: 山脊上有我的脚印，只有一行。
lines.en: On the ridge there is one line of pawprints: mine.

lines.zh: 我对着山谷叫了一声，很长。
lines.en: I call into the valley; the sound runs long.

lines.zh: 这里没有别的猫，暂时。
lines.en: There are no other cats here, for now.

lines.zh: 我找到一块背风的岩石。
lines.en: I find a rock that blocks the wind.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片雪归我巡。
lines.en: From today, I patrol this stretch of snow.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要下岩台。
lines.en: Make way. I'm coming down the ledge.

lines.zh: 雪松林的味道，我熟。
lines.en: The scent of snowy pines is familiar.

lines.zh: 风里有冻土的腥气。
lines.en: The wind carries the smell of frozen earth.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，先吼一声试试。
lines.en: I open my eyes and try a growl.

lines.zh: 雪落在我背上，我不觉得冷。
lines.en: Snow lands on my back and I do not feel cold.

lines.zh: 雪山的冷风，又灌进肺里。
lines.en: Cold mountain air fills my lungs again.

lines.zh: 落在雪上，爪子先试了试。
lines.en: Landing in the snow, I test it with my paws.

lines.zh: 雪落下来，我的斑纹就没了。
lines.en: The snow falls and my spots disappear.

lines.zh: 雪太亮，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: The snow is too bright. I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 这面雪坡，我没来过。
lines.en: I've never been on this slope.

lines.zh: 岩壁的窝，已经空了很久。
lines.en: My ledge den has been empty a long while.

lines.zh: 雪地里潜行，脚印不会骗人。
lines.en: Tracks in the snow never lie.

lines.zh: 火把我背上的毛烧焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire has scorched a patch of fur on my back.

lines.zh: 火燎到我背上的毛了！
lines.en: Fire's caught the fur on my back!

lines.zh: 从崖上滚落，我抓不住岩壁。
lines.en: I tumble from the cliff, claws failing on stone.

lines.zh: 从岩台摔下，肋骨撞石头。
lines.en: I fell from the ledge and cracked my ribs on stone.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进来，我的爪子僵了。
lines.en: Icy water pours in and my claws go stiff.

lines.zh: 雪水灌进毛里，拖我往下。
lines.en: Meltwater soaks my fur and drags me down.

lines.zh: 炸声震得雪崩下来，我转身逃。
lines.en: The blast shakes loose an avalanche; I run.

lines.zh: 雪崩似的巨响，震得我趴下。
lines.en: A blast like an avalanche knocks me flat.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩头，我咬断了箭杆。
lines.en: An arrow is in my shoulder; I bite the shaft off.

lines.zh: 谁在雪坡下放的冷箭？
lines.en: Who loosed that cold arrow from below the slope?

lines.zh: 一股凉意钻进骨头，我站不稳。
lines.en: A coldness sinks into my bones and I stagger.

lines.zh: 没有伤口，皮肉却烧起来。
lines.en: No wound, yet my flesh burns.

lines.zh: 好几天没猎到东西，我腿发软。
lines.en: Days without a kill have left my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雪里没猎物，胃在抽。
lines.en: No prey in the snow; my gut knots.

lines.zh: 雷劈在雪坡上，我的毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the slope and my fur all rises.

lines.zh: 雪山上被雷劈，毛都焦了。
lines.en: Struck by lightning on the mountain, my fur is singed.

lines.zh: 雪和山都消失了，只剩风和黑。
lines.en: Snow and mountain are gone; only wind and dark remain.

lines.zh: 虚空里连雪都没有，我抓着空。
lines.en: No snow in the void; my claws close on nothing.
